key_points: Morgan Stanley announced a $1.3 bn growth‑equity fund, signaling continued capital‑raising and investment activity
Co‑President Dan Simkowitz highlighted growth opportunities in wealth management, AI‑driven financing and a deal‑making rebound, suggesting earnings upside beyond 2026
Shares fell ~1.9% on Sep 16 amid broader market moves but no earnings surprise or guidance change was reported
Most other headlines (Peloton, Southwest, Microsoft, etc.) are unrelated or generic market commentary and add little direct impact
Overall tone is modestly positive with limited short‑term price effect; outlook improves over the next few weeks
